title: Access Ledger: Sparkline role timeline & compact workspace permissions prototype
text:
Access Ledger: Sparkline role timeline & compact workspace permissions prototype

description:
Problem: Admins currently need to jump between multiple Console pages to understand who has access to what, when changes happened, and what those changes cost. This leads to slow access reviews and manual spreadsheets for audits.

Proposal: Design a compact 'Access Ledger' panel that surfaces a per-workspace role timeline (sparkline) for each principal, inline compact role diffs, and a lightweight audit timeline that connects changes to cost signals and rollout events. The prototype focuses on low-visual-noise summaries for rapid reviews, with drill-through to existing audit log rows for full detail.

Audience: Workspace admins, security reviewers, and platform ops teams performing periodic access reviews and incident investigations.

goals:
Reduce time to complete an access review by 40% compared to current multi-page flow
Provide a single-scan UI for spotting anomalous role churn (sudden bursts in sparklines)
Surface cost deltas for role changes where applicable (eg. changes that enable Dedicated endpoints)
Enable safe in-context remediation: reason-capture and temporary revoke flows

scope:
Compact Access Ledger panel embedded in Workspace Settings > Access
Sparkline timeline visualization aggregated by day for last 90 days
Inline compact role diff (before/after) with quick rollback action
Lightweight cost delta badge for changes that touch billing-sensitive roles
Prototype flows for reviewer comments and marking entries 'verified'

out_of_scope:
Full replacement of the audit-log table (drill-through only)
Cross-workspace bulk role changes (handled by Dedicated RBAC tools)
Long-term storage/retention UI controls (backend only)

acceptance_criteria:
Prototype demonstrates sparkline + diff + cost badge in a single compact row
Usability test with 6 org-admin participants shows median task time improvement
Engineering sign-off on data availability for sparkline (daily aggregates) and cost mapping
Design tokens and spacing match Console compact list patterns and pass accessibility audit (AA)

tasks:
Finalize sparkline micro-interaction and tooltip content
Add compact role-diff glyphs and visual language spec to design tokens
Create Figma prototype flows for verify/rollback/comment
Coordinate with ENG to wire up daily aggregate API behind feature flag
Run moderated usability sessions (n=6) and synthesize outcomes

decisions:
Use sparklines aggregated at daily granularity for 90-day window to balance signal/noise
Cost badge only surfaces for changes mapped to billing-impacting roles (avoids alarming admins)
Compact row is primary view with an expandable pane for full audit log rows

risks:
False positives in sparkline churn detection if service account rotations are frequent
Misleading cost deltas if backend mapping between role and billing feature is incomplete
Too much compactness could hide critical context (mitigated by drill-through)

user_research_summary:
Participants liked the single-scan concept but wanted clearer explanations for sparkline spikes
Admins requested an easy way to mark entries as 'reviewed' and export subsets for compliance
Security reviewers asked for immutable links to full audit-row for legal evidence

handoff_notes:
Engineering: deliver mock API contract for daily aggregates and change metadata by 2026-03-22
Design: deliver final tokens and compact row specs (spacing, colors, iconography) in Figma
PM: schedule pilot with two enterprise customers and request compliance checklist from Security

comments:
2026-02-12 - Ava: Initial concept sketched after workshop with PM and ENG. Decided to prioritize compact rows vs full table redesign.
2026-02-18 - Luca: Iterated on sparkline color semantics to highlight temporal increases in privilege count rather than absolute numbers.
2026-02-25 - PM (R. Chen): Requested cost coupling — only show cost badge when change maps to Dedicated/Disk-backed features to avoid noise.
2026-03-03 - Eng (M. Osei): Confirmed daily aggregate endpoint will be available behind feature flag; suggested fallback when data missing.
2026-03-10 - Design Review: UX crit focused on affordance for rollback. Agreed to surface confirmation modal with reason capture and audit entry linking.
2026-03-12 - Usability: Prototype A/B tested with 6 admins; preliminary median completion time improved by ~35%. Action: run expanded test across enterprise customers.
